original_card.first_experiment: Choose one current supplier obligation and trace whether its acceptance depends on an independent check.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Closing a current acceptance gap or proof obligation strengthens reliability even without changing kappa.
allowed_variations: Audit one named current condition using a new semantic counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Reporting the historical timing-only diagnostic as a new current acceptance bug.

actual_scope: One selected supplier obligation traced to its source-bound checks: Lemma A's exact part for the selected frontier1094 gauge44 word, i.e. the 36 stored residual wrappers (RESIDUAL-ADAPTERS.json) satisfy L o F_w o R o T_E = T_end exactly on all 512 columns with global phase, and are exactly the wrappers its programs use.
scope_change_reason: Refined to the one obligation whose acceptance rests only on the producer's own check: the chain pins the wrappers' bytes (owner audit; fresh invoice), its audit (gauge44-slots-t16/code/audit_allcold.py) checks only their structural fields, and their exactness is established only by the producer's own generation-and-decoding (WRAPPER-CHECKS.json, byte-pinned by the fresh invoice but never read for status). Left open by our #1781.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the selected record's soundness, no kappa change. Lemma A turns each entering or hyperplane-ending helper's residual into C_[w] (x) I through these wrappers; an error would leave ranks and the paid profile unchanged but break exact restoration. This gives the first independent, byte-bound check of all 36 for the selected word.
stop_rule: Stop when all 36 records are exact under two calibrated kernels, the inventory ties them to the programs' residual events, and every mutation control is rejected.
evidence: RESULT.json: RESIDUAL-ADAPTERS 383f40aa pinned by the owner audit and the certificate's fresh invoice (which also pins WRAPPER-CHECKS 0ae753d6); 36 records (22 FULL-ended, 12 cold hyperplane-end, 2 entering hyperplane-end) = the word's keys, exact field sets; 240 pre + 240 post residual events per orientation (no other kind), keys correct, pre first and post last; kernel B reproduces #702 (14) and #1415 (3) and equals kernel A on monomials and F_w; 2:999 and 3:998 are Exact.lean pairs 3 and 2; all 36 identities exact on 512 columns with global phase under both kernels (36/36 each; K histogram 4:8, 8:6, 9:22); controls rejected: phase, input character, CZ term, translation, swapped wrappers, width -1, width +1, transposed matrix (36/36 each), hyperplane-end records against FULL (14/14), FULL wrapper reused for a hyperplane end (2/2), frame basis (2/2, reordered rows pass), kernel B mutants (8/8). Prior coverage: 2 Lean pairs, 8 records of #702's family, 4 hyperplane cases of #1697; the 22 FULL-ended records were producer-only. 17 tests pass.
author: Sagar Thakrar (thakrarsagar)
ai_assistance: Substantial: Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code. Parallel read-only scout and judge subagents selected the obligation (both judges ranked it first) and traced the producer-only evidence; the closed-form kernel, verifier and controls were then written fresh, reusing our merged #1781 binding and packed kernel by import with pinned digests. A post-PR adversarial review corrected the supplier trace (fresh-invoice pin), the overlap (#1697, #1611) and credits, and added the kernel B/A cross-check and further controls (second commit).
